content: Yakop ila ivot to waagha Laban
Yakop ipaburigin laghooŋ tooni muul, ve ilaagh ila ivot nugh ee to yes tau taan toozi igheen ila pa aaz puughu na.
Maata ila le ighita sipsip ŋgun tol tighengheen tigharau yaa taiŋ ee. Pasaa, monmon tamtamon titivtiv yaa tawe ve tipapaghun sipsip toozi. Yaa taiŋ tawe, tipoon aavo pa maet babaaŋa.

Nugh tawe gabuazi tauvene: Isaav ighe ravrav izi, ve sipsip tisov tila tivot yaa tawe ziige, mako ŋginiiŋ ŋgaia tilam ve tizuur maet babaaŋa tana ighau ila soghan. Leso titiv yaa ve tipaghun sipsip. Le isov, mako tipoona muul.
Yakop iŋarui yes ŋginiiŋ ŋgaia tawe ila, ve ighason zi ighe: “Zeran tsiau, yam to saa nugh?” Yes tiyol aliiŋa tighe: “Yei to nugh Aran.”
Tauvene Yakop ighason zi muul ighe: “Yam awatagh Laban tau Naor tiimbu, ma mako?” Yes tighe: “Vee, yei niwataghi.”
Yakop ighason zi muul ighe: “Mindai, lepoogh tooni poia?” Yes tiyol aliiŋa tighe: “Vee, i ileep poia. Ughita. Natliva Rael tomania sipsip toozi, ta ŋgarig gha tilam we.”
Ra Yakop isaav pazi muul ighe: “Aghita. Ene aaz tiina, ve sipsip irau tiloŋ tila olol loolo soone. Agham yaa pazi ve tighun le isov, o agham zi timuul tila tighan kikiliiŋ.”
Eemon yes tisaav pani tighe: “Ee-e, vene mako. Yei aat nilepleep ve nisaŋan sipsip tisov tilam peria, o nizuur maet tane ila pa ziige, ve nitiv yaa gha nipaghun zi.”
Yakop tomania yes ŋginiiŋ ŋgaia tana tisavsaav soone, ve Rael igherev sipsip to taama gha tilam tivot. Pasaa, i ta monmon iŋginŋgin zi.
Yakop ighita waagha Laban natliva Rael tomania sipsip tooni, ve iburig ila pa yaa taiŋ tana, izuur maet babaaŋa ila soghan pa yaa aavo, ve itiv yaa pa sipsip gha tighun.
Yakop loolo poia kat pa ighita liivu. Tauta isaghavu ve itaŋ aliiŋa tiina.
Ve ivotia tauu pani ighe: “Yau tane ziiri waaro to tamam! Yau tinaŋ Rebeka.” Rael ilooŋ saveeŋ tane, ve rekia mon ilaan ila peria to taama, ve ipaes pani.

Laban ilooŋ waagha Yakop vaaru, tauvene iburig ve ilaan ila ighe ighita. Ila ivot tooni, ve isaghavu toman tintini. Ve ighamu, gha yesuru timuul tila pa ruum. Ra Yakop ipaesia laghooŋ tooni gha Laban ilooŋa.
Yakop ipaes le isov, ve Laban isaav pani ighe: “Onoon kat, ituru siŋ eemon.”
Yakop igham uraat pa Laban, leso ivai Rael

Yakop ileep tomania Laban irau kaiyo ee, ra Laban izi ve isaav pani ighe: “Onoon, yo ziiri waaro tsiau duduuŋ. Eemon ugham uraat payau sorok, ene poia mako. Tauvene usaav ghazooŋa payau. Ughe nagham saa gabua imin lem atuya?”
Laban natlivaŋa ru. Olman eeza Lea, ve muria eeza Rael.
Lea naagho paghuuna geeg mako. Ve Rael, i livaa paghuuna kat.
Yakop loolo igheen to Rael. Tauvene isaav pa Laban ighe: “Yau naghe navai natumliva Rael. Isaav ighe yo uyok payau, o nagham uraat payo irau ndaman liim ve ru.”
Laban iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Yau lolog pa nagham Rael pa ŋeer ite paam mako. Isaav ighe nagham payo ve uvaii, ene poia kat. Tauvene uleep tomani ghau ve ugham uraat.”
Yakop igham uraat pa Laban irau ndaman liim ve ru, leso ivai Rael. Eemon i ighita ndaman liim ve ru tana imin saawe malau mako. Pasaa, loolo igheen to Rael kat.
Ndaman liim ve ru tana isov, ra Yakop isaav pa Laban ighe: “Saawe tau yo ughuru payau, tauta napasovu wa. Ugham livaa tana ilam gha navaii!”
Tauvene Laban igham marewaaŋ tiina, ve ipoi tamtamon tisov to nugh tawe tilam tilup zi pa ghanghaniiŋ to vaiŋ.
Eemon mboŋ tana, i igham karom, ve ighur natliva olman Lea ila to Yakop ve yesuru tigheen.
Ve igham besooŋa tooni livaa ee, eeza Silpa pa Lea, leso ibesbees pani.

Mboŋoozo, Yakop iburig ve maata izi le ighilaal Lea ighengheen izi ziige! Tauvene ila isaav pa Laban: “Wai, ugham ŋgar tane payau pasaa? Yau nagham uraat payo leso navai Rael. Puughu mindai ta yo utombaan ghau?”
Laban iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Mako. Ta muuŋ ve ilam, tutuuŋ tsiei igheen tauvene: Livaa muria irau ivai imuuŋ pa livaa olman mako.
Tauvene yo uleep le irau ghanghaniiŋ to Lea isov, o naghur Rael paam ilat. Eemon yo aat ugham uraat payau irau ndaman liim ve ru muul.”
Yakop ilooŋ saveeŋ tane, ve itaghoni mon. Tauvene mboŋ liim ve ru to ghanghaniiŋ to vaiŋ tana, i ileep tomania Lea. Ra Laban ighur natliva Rael paam ila tooni.
Ve ighur besooŋa tooni livaa ite, eeza Bila, ila to Rael, leso ibesbees pani.
Tauvene Yakop yesuru Rael tigheen paam. Yakop loolo igheen to Rael kat. Eemon Lea, Yakop loolo pani kat mako. Yakop ileep tomania Laban, ve igham uraat pani irau ndaman liim ve ru muul.
Yakop natŋa
Yoova ighita Yakop loolo pa Lea kat mako. Tauvene iuul Lea le aapo. Eemon Rael, i uupa.
Lea ipoop naatu aidaaba, ve isaav ighe: “Yoova ighita pataŋani tsiau, tauta igham leg natug tane. Aazne, aat azuwag loolo igheen tsiau.” Tauvene iwaat naatu tawe eeza Ruben.

Tilepleep le Lea aapo muul, ve ipoop naatu tamoot ite. Tauvene isaav ighe: “Yoova ilooŋ taŋiiz tsiau, ve iwatagh ighe azuwag loolo igheen tsiau kat mako. Tauta igham leg natug ite tane.” Tauvene Lea iwaat naatu tawe eeza Simeon.

Tilepleep le Lea aapo muul, ve ipoop naatu tamoot ite imin tol. Tauvene isaav ighe: “Aazne, aat azuwag loolo isaghav ghau rig. Pasaa, napoop le natŋa zitamoot tol wa.” Tauta iwaat naatu tawe eeza Levi.
Tilepleep le Lea aapo muul, ve ipoop naatu tamoot ite imin paaŋ. Tauvene isaav ighe: “Aazne, yau napakur Yoova.” Tauta iwaat naatu tawe eeza Yuda.
Lea ipoop Yuda, ra popaaŋ tooni imot, ve ileep le malau.
